result.topic_en: Riemann notes that the values of z belonging to the same value of ζ are linear fractional (Möbius) transforms of one another, and computes how the derivative ∂z/∂ζ and the quantities 1/√(∂z/∂ζ) and z/√(∂z/∂ζ) transform under such a substitution.
result.transcription:
Ausdruck von $\zeta$ durch $z$ zu finden.
$\zeta \ddagger \zeta'$ || $\frac{z-p}{r} \ddagger \frac{r}{z'-p'}$
$\zeta \ddagger \zeta'$ $\frac{z-p_1}{r_1} \ddagger$
Die verschiedenen Werthe welche $z$ annehmen kann, während $\zeta$ wieder denselben Werth annimmt, sind also [-algebraische-] rationale Functionen ersten Grades von einem dieser Werthe.
$z \ddagger \frac{az+b}{cz+d}$
$\frac{\partial z}{\partial \zeta} \ddagger \frac{(ad-bc)}{(cz+d)^2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial \zeta}$
[-$\sqrt{z}$-]
$\frac{1}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \zeta}}} \ddagger \frac{1}{\sqrt{(ad-bc)}}$ | $c\frac{z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \zeta}}} + \frac{d}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \zeta}}}$
$\frac{z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \zeta}}} \ddagger \frac{1}{\sqrt{ad-bc}}$ | $a\frac{z}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \zeta}}} + \frac{b}{\sqrt{\frac{\partial z}{\partial \zeta}}}$

methods.what: Inversion in a circle relating corresponding points z and z' (reflection-type correspondence)
The values of z belonging to the same ζ are related by a linear fractional (Möbius) transformation
Transformation of the derivative under a Möbius map
The pair (z/√(∂z/∂ζ), 1/√(∂z/∂ζ)) transforms linearly (up to the factor 1/√(ad−bc)) under the Möbius map
Conformal mapping as an analytic function of a complex variable

items.english: To find the expression of ζ in terms of z.

items.quote: Die verschiedenen Werthe welche $z$ annehmen kann, während $\zeta$ wieder denselben Werth annimmt, sind also [-algebraische-] rationale Functionen ersten Grades von einem dieser Werthe.
items.english: The different values which z can take while ζ again takes the same value are therefore rational functions of the first degree of one of these values.
